fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Senna''' fires a massive beam in the target direction. The beam consists of a broad wave of light, and a narrow wave of shadow at the center.
fields.description2: The shadow wave deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 3 seconds, as well as hits all ''{{ai|Absolution|Senna|Mist Wraiths}}''.
fields.description3: The light wave grants a {{tip|shield}} to '''Senna''' and allied champions hit for 3 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of {{tt|the area|Can see through brush and terrain.}} along the path for 2 seconds.
fields.notes:
* The broad wave is a singular projectile that can be {{tip|projectile|destroyed}}.
** The narrow wave will be destroyed with it in the process.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* '''Senna''' reveals herself during the cast time.
